descriptions.inProgress: Master Sergeant Fox asked me to meet #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Sergeant Bravo, and Corporal Easy#k in order. I met them all just as Master Sergeant Fox told me. I should be returning to him right away.
descriptions.completed: Just like the way Master Sergeant Fox requested, I met his men in order of ranks and got the 3 pieces of an ancient document to him. He was really happy about it, and gave me the scroll made out of those pieces. He also wished that I could drop by sometime later and see how the other men are doing...maybe I should...
